name: Meridian group EU design review (GDPR, DORA), alternate

controls.title: Encryption at rest and key management
controls.requirement: All customer data at rest must be encrypted, and the design must state the key model: customer-managed or provider-managed keys, where they are held, and the rotation period. Vague statements such as 'industry-standard encryption' do not meet this requirement.
controls.applicability: Applies when the application processes personal data of EU or EEA data subjects or supports an EU entity's ICT services.

framework_map.status: illustrative; not reviewed by a compliance owner

controls.title: Encryption in transit
controls.requirement: All network connections carrying customer data must be encrypted, with the minimum TLS version stated as a number.
controls.applicability: Applies when the application processes personal data of EU or EEA data subjects or supports an EU entity's ICT services.

framework_map.status: illustrative; not reviewed by a compliance owner

controls.title: Data residency and processing region
controls.requirement: The processing and storage region must be stated for every data store and processor. The design must state whether any personal data is transferred outside the EEA, and the transfer mechanism if so.
controls.applicability: Applies when the application processes personal data of EU or EEA data subjects or supports an EU entity's ICT services.

framework_map.status: illustrative; not reviewed by a compliance owner

controls.title: Personal data inventory
controls.requirement: Personal data must be inventoried by category, the data subjects must be named, and the document must state whether special category data is processed.
controls.applicability: Applies when the application processes personal data of EU or EEA data subjects or supports an EU entity's ICT services.

framework_map.status: illustrative; not reviewed by a compliance owner

controls.title: Retention and deletion
controls.requirement: A retention period must be stated as a number with a unit, and a deletion mechanism such as a job, lifecycle rule or TTL must be described.
controls.applicability: Applies when the application processes personal data of EU or EEA data subjects or supports an EU entity's ICT services.

framework_map.status: illustrative; not reviewed by a compliance owner

controls.title: Processors and sub-processors
controls.requirement: Every processor and sub-processor that can access personal data must be listed in the design, and the list must match the processing agreements in the package.
controls.applicability: Applies when the application processes personal data of EU or EEA data subjects or supports an EU entity's ICT services.

framework_map.status: illustrative; not reviewed by a compliance owner

required_clauses: list matches agreements in the package

controls.title: Network segmentation and trust boundaries
controls.requirement: Network segmentation must be described, trust boundaries shown, and every inbound path and the internet egress posture stated.
controls.applicability: Applies when the application processes personal data of EU or EEA data subjects or supports an EU entity's ICT services.

framework_map.status: illustrative; not reviewed by a compliance owner

controls.title: Least-privilege access
controls.requirement: Access must use named roles scoped to specific resources. There must be no shared administrator account, and human access to production data must not be standing.
controls.applicability: Applies when the application processes personal data of EU or EEA data subjects or supports an EU entity's ICT services.

framework_map.status: illustrative; not reviewed by a compliance owner

controls.title: Security logging and monitoring
controls.requirement: Security events must be logged to a protected location, with a numeric retention period and a description of alerting and its routing.
controls.applicability: Applies when the application processes personal data of EU or EEA data subjects or supports an EU entity's ICT services.

framework_map.status: illustrative; not reviewed by a compliance owner

controls.title: Rollback and recovery
controls.requirement: A rollback plan for deployments must exist, and RTO and RPO must be stated as numbers.
controls.applicability: Applies when the application processes personal data of EU or EEA data subjects or supports an EU entity's ICT services.
